status: PPO core aligned with pinned CrazyRL/RSL semantics; implementation and all hyperparameters are not claimed identical.

aligned_core.before: Standardize every minibatch with population std.
aligned_core.now: rsl_aligned standardizes complete rollout once using sample std(ddof=1), matching normalize_advantage_per_mini_batch=false.

aligned_core.before: Sampled-action approximation mean(exp(logratio)-1-logratio), changes LR after applying gradient, cap1e-3.
aligned_core.now: Analytic old-Gaussian||new-Gaussian KL, including pinned RSL log(std_new/std_old+1e-5); changes LR before applying the current gradient, bounds1e-5..1e-2 and positive-KL growth guard.
rsl_aligned epsilon1e-8, beta1=.9/beta2=.999, global gradient-norm cap1, matching saved Torch optimizer defaults.
rsl_aligned default normalization_until100000000; stop later rollout updates once count reaches limit. Threshold crossing can overshoot by one rollout batch.

already_matched.networks: Actor344→256→256→128→64→4 and critic434→256→256→128→64→1, ELU hidden layers and linear outputs.
already_matched.rollout_and_loss: Horizon120; fiveepochs; gamma.99/lambda.95; ratio clip.2; clipped-value loss coefficient1 without extra half; entropy coefficient.005.
already_matched.action: Unbounded four-dimensional Gaussian: roll attitude, pitch attitude, yaw rate, collective thrust. Log probability refers to raw sample; environment applies tanh once. Physics is excluded from gradients.

remaining_explicit_differences.jax: Random-action horizon calibration; freeze moments throughout rollout and gradient epochs; merge raw observation moments after PPO.
remaining_explicit_differences.rsl: Update moments at each returned env observation and store already normalized observations.
remaining_explicit_differences.assessment: Intentional retained JAX difference. Copying only final moments into old normalized samples would be incorrect; full online alignment needs a separate rollout-buffer design and ablation.

remaining_explicit_differences.rsl: Saved scalar mode optimizes direct std vector4 without the logstd transform. Initial std1 in both.
remaining_explicit_differences.assessment: Same distribution contract at equal values, different optimizer geometry. Retained for stability; no evidence it explains transfer gap.

remaining_explicit_differences.jax: Orthogonal hidden weights gain sqrt2, actor output gain.01, critic output gain1, zero biases.
remaining_explicit_differences.rsl: Default Torch Linear fan-in uniform weights and biases; optional orthogonal helper is not called.
remaining_explicit_differences.assessment: Retained conventional JAX PPO initialization; separate from architecture compatibility.

remaining_explicit_differences.jax: New permutation each epoch; batch must divide exactly by minibatch count. Default hardware setting32, study also64.
remaining_explicit_differences.rsl: One permutation reused across epochs; saved baseline200 minibatches; floor division drops remainder.
remaining_explicit_differences.assessment: No strict hyperparameter identity claim. Compare samples/minibatch and optimizer-step budgets, not only minibatch count.

remaining_explicit_differences.jax: Bootstrap actual pre-reset terminal next-state critic value, mask true terminals to0; every reset stops GAE recursion.
remaining_explicit_differences.rsl: Timeout reward augmentation uses current transition value before resetting done recursion.
remaining_explicit_differences.assessment: Keep mathematically correct JAX next-state bootstrap; do not reproduce RSL current-value approximation.

remaining_explicit_differences.jax: JAX/Flax/Optax functional JIT/scan with batched Crazyflow physics. Full resume uses checkpoint.msgpack.
remaining_explicit_differences.rsl: Torch PPO with Isaac rollout storage and Torch optimizer.
remaining_explicit_differences.assessment: PT is real RSL tensor export for inference, not Torch optimizer resume. Frozen Isaac evaluation physics remain unchanged.

legacy_compatibility.resume: Canonicalize missing historical variant/until fields to legacy/None; aligned and legacy configs do not compare equal. Actual msgpack Agent+environment restoration reproduces the next update exactly for both legacy and rsl_aligned.
legacy_compatibility.old_selected_policy: Existing selected weights and its historical performance are unchanged by source updates.

batch_scaling.study: 1024/32 minibatches and2048/64 both3840 samples/minibatch; equal122.88M transitions imply160000 Adam steps at fiveepochs.
batch_scaling.qualification: More envs do not guarantee higher throughput or more geometry diversity. Map replacement follows reset batches; compare map count/curriculum as well as transitions, wall time and success.
